verified: Store hashes actual bytes, checks length/hash on every read, uses create-if-absent hard links, rejects corrupt existing content and symlink/path traversal, and returns frozen parsed objects. Root/ancestor rename by an untrusted concurrent process is explicitly outside its threat model.

Caller supplies independent publication and admission pin arguments. Lock loader checks role pins, reviewed evidence pins, exact original public source versus normalized projection/native identities, protocol roster/edition, and ordered scored subset plus displayed complement. Private WeakSet brands reject copied or caller-asserted loaded objects.

Ledger loader requires a caller-selected head at the end of an explicit predecessor chain. It verifies each historical revision, source and evidence bytes, record predecessor and ID/revision uniqueness, one record ID per race, and keeps superseded records while exposing only selected-head records.

For the reviewed earlier Senate comparison, rubric validation fixes all 35 displayed pairs, exact ordered 32 plurality core for the primary grade and AK/GA/ME as explicit ungraded display rows. The bridge preserves all 35 evaluation rows and only derives paired losses for declared grade targets.

TS operator matches pinned Python operator in synthetic plurality, RCV, GA runoff, tie, outside-office-winner and preliminary cases. Both use locked pair counts as denominator, retain zero tie margin while withholding binary lead, and require certified/contest-final/no pending recount or dispute for operator final eligibility. TS also rejects counts outside safe integer range.

Evaluator checks declared resultRuleId against observation when either supplies it for Senate winner and all margins; scoring bridge requires protocol and scored IDs equal the rubric target rule ID. A changed counting rule with unchanged event/round does not silently score.

The scoring test uses exact raw editorial rubric bytes and invented lock, result source, reviews and outcomes to exercise lock→ledger→bridge→gradeElectionNightRubric, producing analytic A/A/A; it does not score a real 2026 result.
